title: HBM Out of Memory (Error 1000) Triage Workflow
description: End-to-end diagnostic workflow for triaging TPU HBM Out of Memory (`RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Out of memory in memory space hbm` Error E1000) and disambiguating compile-time static HBM OOM vs runtime HBM fragmentation vs host RAM OOM (exit code 137). Directly addresses [[hbm-oom]] and [[tpu-coordinator-oom]].
